meals.name: Spinach & Feta Omelette
meals.instructions:
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Wilt the spinach in the oil over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs, scatter the feta and cook until just set.
Fold and serve with toasted sourdough.

meals.name: Lentil Soup with Sourdough
meals.instructions:
Soften the onion and carrot in a splash of stock for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, cumin and remaining stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then blend half for a creamy texture.
Serve with the sourdough.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese & Pineapple
meals.instructions:
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple.

meals.name: Chicken Stir-fry with Noodles
meals.instructions:
Cook the noodles, drain and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the vegetables and ginger and cook for 3 minutes more.
Toss through the noodles and soy sauce.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
meals.instructions:
Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the berries, oats and chia seeds.
Drizzle with maple syrup and eat straight away.

meals.name: Chicken Quinoa Bowl
meals.instructions:
Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 150 ml water for 12–15 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Season the chicken and cook in half the olive oil over medium-high heat, 5–6 minutes per side.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice and honey to make the dressing.
Slice the chicken and avocado, and halve the tomatoes.
Layer spinach, quinoa, chicken and vegetables in a bowl and drizzle with the dressing.

meals.name: Apple & Peanut Butter
meals.instructions:
Core the apple and cut it into wedges.
Serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

meals.name: Salmon, Rice & Greens
meals.instructions:
Cook the rice according to the pack, about 25 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Rub the salmon with oil, garlic and soy sauce and bake for 12–14 minutes.
Steam the broccoli and green beans for 4–5 minutes.
Serve the salmon over the rice with the greens on the side.

meals.name: Overnight Oats with Banana
meals.instructions:
Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and cinnamon together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced banana in the morning.

meals.name: Turkey & Hummus Wrap
meals.instructions:
Spread the hummus over the wrap.
Layer the turkey, cucumber and spinach.
Roll tightly, slice in half and serve.

meals.name: Hummus & Veg Sticks
meals.instructions:
Cut the vegetables into sticks.
Serve with the hummus.

meals.name: Beef Chilli with Rice
meals.instructions:
Brown the mince with the onion.
Add the tomatoes, beans and chilli powder and simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve the chilli on top.

meals.name: Protein Pancakes
meals.instructions:
Blend the oats, eggs, banana and cottage cheese until smooth.
Cook ladlefuls in a non-stick pan, 2 minutes per side.
Serve topped with berries.

meals.name: Tuna Pasta Salad
meals.instructions:
Cook the pasta, then rinse under cold water.
Stir the yogurt with lemon juice and black pepper.
Toss everything together and chill until lunch.

meals.name: Protein Shake
meals.instructions: Shake the protein with cold milk until smooth.

meals.name: Tofu Curry with Rice
meals.instructions:
Fry the tofu until golden.
Stir in the curry paste, then the coconut milk.
Simmer for 10 minutes and wilt in the spinach.
Serve over rice with a pinch of garam masala.
